agent_config.standard.patch.yml:
# DSH Standard (profile sdk): stock tree; the pi-ai row from base carries no routes here, the bench row owns local-ollama.
- id: session-log-deepseek
  config:
    enabled: false
- id: tool-web
  disabled: true
- id: web-search-deepseek
  disabled: true
- id: web-fetch-http
  disabled: true

# Model route: configure the pi-ai adapter dsh-base already mounts (a second instance does not register).
- id: llm-pi-ai
  config:
    providers:
      local-ollama:
        displayName: Local Ollama (bench relay)
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1
        apiKeyEnv: DSH_BENCH_API_KEY
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: 1200000
        retryPolicy:
          mode: normal
          maxRetries: 0
        compat:
          supportsDeveloperRole: false
        models:
          - id: !!js process.env.DSH_BENCH_MODEL
            contextWindow: 65536
            maxTokens: 8192
            reasoningEfforts: false
agent_config.minimal.patch.yml:
# DSH Minimal (profile sdk-minimal): stock tree; its DeepSeek adapter is unused (the bench route is local-ollama).
- id: session-log-deepseek
  config:
    enabled: false

# Model route (was common.patch.yml): pi-ai's OpenAI-compatible adapter to the in-container relay.
- insert:
    - id: llm-pi-ai-bench
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai'
      config:
        providers:
          local-ollama:
            displayName: Local Ollama (bench relay)
            api: openai-completions
            baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1
            apiKeyEnv: DSH_BENCH_API_KEY
            streamIdleTimeoutMs: 1200000
            retryPolicy:
              mode: normal
              maxRetries: 0
            compat:
              supportsDeveloperRole: false
            models:
              - id: !!js process.env.DSH_BENCH_MODEL
                contextWindow: 65536
                maxTokens: 8192
                reasoningEfforts: false
